title: Add one-tap quick-start prompts to the empty Chat screen
goal: Make a new conversation immediately useful by showing four common task starters that populate the composer for review before sending.
context: The empty Chat screen currently offers only a generic introduction and a link to the larger prompt library. Quick starts reduce time-to-first-use while keeping the user in control of the actual request.
forbidden_changes: Do not auto-submit a selected prompt.
Do not change Agent routing, execution, policy, or provider behavior.
Do not remove or replace the existing prompt library, cancellation, streaming, or conversation controls.
Do not claim physical-device acceptance without testing a real iPhone.
acceptance_criteria: An empty conversation displays four quick-start actions: explain, plan, write, and investigate an error.
Selecting a quick start fills the existing composer and focuses it without submitting.
The quick starts are not shown over an existing conversation history.
The existing prompt library button remains available.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Review SwiftUI state flow and accessibility labels/hints.
Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
Verify quick-start selection on a physical iPhone before claiming device acceptance.
recovery: If layout becomes cramped on smaller devices, keep the actions compact or use a horizontal scrolling row without changing the fill-only behavior. Revert the UI-only change if it breaks existing Chat composition.
